chapter_title: Concerning the Three Things that were established by the Light
chapter_note: A remarkably pure chapter. After the formulaic dialogue frame opener (P1), the entire teaching body (P2-6) is oldest-layer eschatological cosmology. The three-fold enumeration maps cosmic necessity: (1) the new luminous earth built over this earth, (2) the coffin/prison of the dark fire, (3) condemned souls crucified on the enemy. The final paragraph describes the sealing of the final lump and the permanent separation/sterilization of Darkness. Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system throughout. No citations, no institutional references, no contemporary application, no exhortation. The zero substrate vocabulary score reflects the narrow vocabulary list (zoomorphic/metal/taste markers), not the actual teaching character. Significant lacunae in P3-4 obscure details of the first two cosmic necessities.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Pure formulaic attribution: 'Once again he speaks to his disciples.' The additional qualifier 'these who are not associates in the mystery of his knowledge' is unusual but still part of the frame — it characterizes the audience, not the teaching content. Bridge connective correctly detected.

paragraphs.core_text: Three things would be fashioned by the Light through necessity. For there can be no other way nor other result, to allow them to stay without coming about. For the Darkness, the enemy, must be bound by them; he who stood up against the Light from the beginning. Due to this, these things have no (other) result, to allow them to stay without coming about.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Impersonal cosmological teaching: describes the systematic necessity within the Light-Darkness opposition. Both sides of the mapping are cosmic entities (Light, Darkness). The repeated emphasis on necessity ('no other way', 'no other result') is characteristic of process-oriented substrate teaching describing what MUST happen given the cosmic architecture. The repetition may be deliberate rhetorical structure in the teaching tradition.

paragraphs.core_text: Now, the first thing is the new luminous earth, which was set and built on top of this earth [ ... ] it, namely that alien body [ ... ] built upon it.
paragraphs.temporal_note: First enumeration unit of the three-fold teaching. Describes cosmic geography: the new luminous earth built upon this earth. 'Alien body' is a cosmological term for the constructed entity. Significant lacunae obscure detail. Enumeration marker preserved as per protocol.

paragraphs.core_text: The second thing is this: They will [ ... ] and they [ ... ] the new earth, the coffin [ ... ] ⟨p.105⟩ of the dark fire, the companion of the enemy.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second enumeration unit. Despite heavy lacunae, the surviving terms are all cosmic: new earth, coffin (as cosmic container/prison), dark fire, the enemy. The 'coffin' functions as a correspondential image for the imprisonment of darkness — both sides stay within the cosmic system. Page marker ⟨p.105⟩ preserved.

paragraphs.core_text: The third thing is the souls of all the sinners who have been condemned by their deeds. They were [ ... ] over them woe; they have been condemned according to the wicked deeds they had committed, and due to this they will be crucified on the enemy, he who had raised himself up against the greatness.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third enumeration unit. 'Souls of sinners' functions as a cosmic eschatological category — the final lump of unredeemed light-substance — not a moral address to a contemporary audience. 'Crucified on the enemy' is cosmic process: the damned souls become part of the enemy's prison. No voice shift to exhortation; no 'therefore you should' pivot. Both sides stay within the cosmic system.

paragraphs.core_text: They will seal up this final lump when all the likenesses and images of every shape will be nailed in it. Also, those will be bound by this last fetter for eternity, and be placed as a footstool and a mat and a rag for this coffin [ ... ] which is the prison of the enemy. It will be placed, being a boundary-marker and a great void between the two, between the Darkness and the enemy, so that they cannot reach one another, nor can they hear their voices; rather they will become sterile as they are separated from each other for ever and ever.
paragraphs.temporal_note: The culmination of the teaching: the sealing of the final lump and the permanent separation of Darkness. 'Footstool and a mat and a rag' are correspondential descriptions of the lump's cosmic function — not contemporary metaphors. 'Boundary-marker and a great void between the two' is cosmic geography. The sterilization of Darkness through separation of its powers is systematic cosmological teaching about the final state. The low exhortation score (2.83) is likely triggered by 'for ever and ever' as a closing formula, but here it describes cosmic duration, not devotional closure. No voice shift to audience address anywhere.
